definition: The Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM) catalog identifier for Spastic paraplegia 93, autosomal recessive (SPG93), a neurodegenerative condition caused by homozygous or compound heterozygous mutations in the NFU1 gene on chromosome 2p13.

source.title: Spastic Paraplegia 93, Autosomal Recessive (SPG93)
source.quote: Autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia 93 (SPG93) is caused by homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the NFU1 gene on chromosome 2p13.
